title: Three-level safety training for site entry
summary: We impose mandatory three-tier safety education with fixed hourly durations before site access to ensure all personnel meet our HSE baseline.

content.overview: We require all incoming personnel to complete company-level, project-level, and team-level safety training and pass examinations to ensure consistent hazard awareness and compliance with our site HSE rules.
content.details: Company-level training: minimum 24 hours. Project-level: minimum 16 hours. Team-level: minimum 8 hours. Special operations personnel must hold valid certificates matching their work; we enforce one-to-one matching of person and license. This structured cascade ensures that generic safety policies, project-specific risks, and daily task hazards are covered sequentially, providing a layered defense against ignorance-based incidents.
content.examples: Training hours: company ≥24h, project ≥16h, team ≥8h. Special workers: welding, electrical, scaffolding, etc., must present current certificates and pass on-site verification before starting work.
content.caveats: Training must be documented and refreshed periodically; failing to verify certificate authenticity could lead to unqualified personnel accessing critical tasks.
